ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #10
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Skipping all moral lessons
   B. Refusing to help a neighbour
   C. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   D. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

2. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Destroy trees without planting
   B. Pollute rivers deliberately
   C. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   D. Waste food daily

3. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on good Behaviour? (1 mark)
   A. Say Hadith on good Behaviour has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Hadith on good Behaviour with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Hadith on good Behaviour to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on good Behaviour.

4. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on Greetings? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on Greetings.
   B. Say Hadith on Greetings has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of Hadith on Greetings with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Hadith on Greetings to insult classmates of other faiths.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on Gratitude? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on Gratitude.
   B. Say Hadith on Gratitude has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Hadith on Gratitude to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Hadith on Gratitude with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

6. Which response best shows understanding of Belief in Angels 3.2.1 Characteristics of angels? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Belief in Angels 3.2.1 Characteristics of angels with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Belief in Angels 3.2.1 Characteristics of angels.
   C. Use Belief in Angels 3.2.1 Characteristics of angels to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Belief in Angels 3.2.1 Characteristics of angels has no place in daily life.

7. Which response best shows understanding of Belief in Allah 3.1.1 Attributes of Allah: Forgiver) Knowing) Protector) Living)? (1 mark)
   A. Say Belief in Allah 3.1.1 Attributes of Allah: Forgiver) Knowing) Protector) Living) has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Belief in Allah 3.1.1 Attributes of Allah: Forgiver) Knowing) Protector) Living).
   C. Apply the teaching of Belief in Allah 3.1.1 Attributes of Allah: Forgiver) Knowing) Protector) Living) with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Belief in Allah 3.1.1 Attributes of Allah: Forgiver) Knowing) Protector) Living) to insult classmates of other faiths.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Sunnah Prayers Qabliyah and Ba'diyah? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Sunnah Prayers Qabliyah and Ba'diyah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Sunnah Prayers Qabliyah and Ba'diyah has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Sunnah Prayers Qabliyah and Ba'diyah.
   D. Use Sunnah Prayers Qabliyah and Ba'diyah to insult classmates of other faiths.

9. Which response best shows understanding of Belief in Prophets 3.3.1 Qualities of Prophets? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Belief in Prophets 3.3.1 Qualities of Prophets with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Belief in Prophets 3.3.1 Qualities of Prophets.
   C. Use Belief in Prophets 3.3.1 Qualities of Prophets to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Belief in Prophets 3.3.1 Qualities of Prophets has no place in daily life.

10. Which response best shows understanding of Miracles of Prophets? (1 mark)
   A. Use Miracles of Prophets to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Miracles of Prophets has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Miracles of Prophets.
   D. Apply the teaching of Miracles of Prophets with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

11. Which response best shows understanding of Selected Surah:? (1 mark)
   A. Say Selected Surah: has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Selected Surah: with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Selected Surah: to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Selected Surah:.

12. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Spreading rumours
   B. Cheating in exams
   C. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   D. Hiding stolen items

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Prohibitions in Islam Evils of Gambling and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Dua Dua on Increase in Knowledge 02 Page 12 of 64 xii 6 Muamalat 6.1 Etiquette o and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Dua Dua On Increase In Knowledge and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Etiquette of Islamic Wedding Celebrations 03 6.2 Rights of Neighbours 03 6.3 Isl and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
